name: Data Collection & Inventory
description: Identified and acquired 12 geospatial datasets spanning fire history, climate, topography, vegetation, population, infrastructure, and wind data.
deliverables: Data dictionary documenting all variables and sources
Unified directory structure on research server

name: Data Preprocessing & Grid Construction
description: Built a unified 800-meter grid in EPSG:3310 (California Albers Equal Area), reprojecting and resampling all datasets to a common spatial framework.
deliverables: Temporal alignment across heterogeneous time ranges

name: Exploratory Data Analysis — Fire Datasets
description: Comprehensive EDA of CAL FIRE, MTBS, and FPA-FOD fire datasets — temporal trends, spatial distributions, cause analysis, and cross-dataset validation.
deliverables: Cross-reference validation between CAL FIRE and MTBS

name: Exploratory Data Analysis — Environmental
description: EDA of topography (elevation, slope, aspect, TPI), LANDFIRE canopy cover, and FVEG vegetation classification — terrain and fuel characterization.

name: Exploratory Data Analysis — Climate
description: Three-part PRISM climate analysis: CONUS comparison, California deep dive, and fire-climate overlay. VPD identified as the single strongest climate predictor.

name: Exploratory Data Analysis — Human & Wind
description: Census population/housing analysis for WUI characterization, infrastructure-fire proximity analysis, and comprehensive wind/ERC fire weather analysis.
deliverables: WUI population growth quantified (200% faster than non-WUI)

name: Statistical Analysis & Feature Engineering
description: Rigorous statistical analysis — correlation matrices, spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I), principal component analysis, and feature selection for the ML pipeline.
deliverables: Multivariate correlation analysis across all 12 datasets
Feature importance ranking for model input selection

name: Deep Learning Model Development
description: Design and train a spatiotemporal deep learning model (CNN+LSTM hybrid or Vision Transformer) on the 800m grid to predict fire risk, severity, and spread probability.
deliverables: Training on 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96GB each)
Temporal cross-validation with held-out fire seasons
Comparison against baseline models (logistic regression, random forest)

name: Validation & Deployment
description: Model validation against recent fire seasons, interpretability analysis (SHAP/GradCAM), and deployment as a real-time risk assessment tool.
deliverables: Spatial interpretability maps (which features drive predictions where)
